opening.argument: The video is an educational overview of Microsoft certifications: it explains that the certification line has three tiers and describes MTA as a pre-entry level and MCSA as the entry level. The speaker also says that subsequent videos will explore what the certifications offer in greater depth. Separately, the description promotes an online learning membership with a discount code. That promotion is presented without evidence of deceptive conduct or a mechanism for a scam; it does not change the video’s central focus on explaining certification levels and planned instruction.

citations.quote: The Microsoft certification line has three different tiers.

The MTA, the. Microsoft Technology Associate, which is basically a pre-entry type of level of a certification line. The MCSA, which is the Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate, that's a mouthful, which is. The entry level certification line.
In the next coming videos that I have, I will be going in. Depth on the Microsoft certifications what each of them kind of have to offer.
